articles.summary: Tennr and OpenAI announced a partnership on Nov. 16. Together, the companies will push prior authorization workflows forward by deploying computer-using agents to authorization tasks. Tennr's same deep expertise in provider workflows and payer standards, made more powerful by OpenAI's frontier models.
articles.title: Tennr and OpenAI: Advancing Computer Use for Prior Authorization

articles.summary: Doug Hock, former executive at Texas Children’s Hospital, Children’s Health in Dallas, and The Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia, joins us as a strategic advisor to guide Tennr's expansion to more deeply serve health systems.
articles.title: Doug Hock Joins Tennr as a Strategic Advisor for Health Systems
